items.title: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.2
items.summary: 2026.10.10-beta.2 Highlights Changes Fixes Workspace safety: reject a multi-file apply_patch before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval. Tool policy: run plugin before_tool_call hooks in standalone openclaw agent exec sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus. Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa. macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen. OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default openrouter/auto model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus. macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246) Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa. Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen. Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017) Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297) Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy. Windows Claude CLI: stop every turn with a stored Anthropic credential from stalling until the no-output watchdog when Claude Code never reads the credential pipe. (#174571; fixes #174204) Thanks @RomneyDa and @scalesmart. Plugins: restore the SDK facade exports that published external plugins still import, so those plugins load again. (#173777; fixes #173386) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian. Chat tools: keep the chat usable after removing a tool server that failed to start, cleaning up its failed startup before reporting the launch error. (#171397) Thanks @joelagnel. Updates: bound the post-activation Doctor step by the update's allowance instead of waiting indefinitely with the Gateway down. (#173862) Updates: keep Gateway-managed source updates from failing with missing backup modules after the runtime is replaced. (#173587) Thanks @vishnusenthil-16. Updates: make openclaw update --no-restart honest for npm, pnpm, and bun installs, which restart themselves after the package is replaced, record the update as successful, and keep a still-serving older build unverified. (#173409, #174649; fixes #171311) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson. Complete contribution record This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.1..f90bd06 history: 24 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 24 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact. Shipped baseline exclusions: v2026.10.10-beta.1 (1 PRs: #171016). items.summary: 晶片供應商Microchip於10月12日宣布擴充資料中心產品組合，為Flashtec SSD控制器引進後量子密碼學支援，並推出強化安全性功能的Switchtec PCIe 6.0交換器，更新Flashtec SSD控制器及Adaptec SmartRAID 4300系列NVMe RAID儲存加速器，因應AI資料中心對連線效能、儲存容量

items.title: 162個M365租戶遭未授權存取，ConnectWise備份API憑證遭濫用
items.summary: 資安業者Huntress於10月16日揭露，ConnectWise Cloud Backup的Microsoft 365應用程式憑證遭到濫用，攻擊者藉此未經授權登入162個Microsoft 365租戶。

items.title: Adobe於10月上半修補176個資安漏洞
items.summary: 10月13日Adobe發布本月上半的例行更新，為11種應用程式及系統元件推出修補程式，總共修補了176個資安漏洞。

items.title: AI發展與普及速度受制於安全性不足，SailPoint創辦人呼籲整個產業持續投入並付諸行動
items.summary: 近期頂尖AI模型服務失控事件引發關注，日前造訪香港的SailPoint執行長暨創辦人Mark McClain表示，AI不會也不該停下發展的腳步，關鍵在於設法提升AI安全性。他也談到該公司提倡的適應性身分，這是為了因應動態環境即時處理需求而發展的身分防護機制。最後，為了讓大家理解AI與安全性之間的關係，他特別用F1賽車為喻，指出煞車是否完善，是影響跑車能否發揮速度的關鍵，AI也是如此。
